caption: The drawing depicts a single object, specifically a pair of rusted iron pincers or pliers, placed diagonally across a plain, off-white background. The pincers consist of two long, straight handles that meet at a central pivot point, just before the gripping section. The gripping end has a curved, hook-like appearance and is thick and slightly blunt, showing surface details like rust, wear, and metallic texture, depicted in shades of brown, reddish-brown, and dark gray.
